A capacitor (originally known as a condenser) is a passive two-terminal electrical component used to store energyelectrostatically in an electric field. The forms of practical capacitors vary widely, but all contain at least two electrical conductors (plates) separated by a dielectric (i.e. insulator). The conductors can be thin films, foils or sintered beads of metal or conductive electrolyte, etc. The “nonconducting” dielectric acts to increase the capacitor’s charge capacity. A dielectric can be glass, ceramic, plastic film, air, vacuum, paper, mica, oxide layer etc. Capacitors are widely used as parts of electrical circuits in many common electrical devices. Unlike a resistor, an ideal capacitor does not dissipate energy. Instead, a capacitor stores energy in the form of an electrostatic field between its plates.

When there is a potential difference across the conductors (e.g., when a capacitor is attached across a battery), an electric field develops across the dielectric, causing positive charge +Q to collect on one plate and negative charge −Q to collect on the other plate. If a battery has been attached to a capacitor for a sufficient amount of time, no current can flow through the capacitor. However, if a time-varying voltage is applied across the leads of the capacitor, a displacement current can flow.

An ideal capacitor is characterized by a single constant value for its capacitance. Capacitance is expressed as the ratio of the electric charge Q on each conductor to the potential difference V between them. The SI unit of capacitance is the farad (F), which is equal to one coulomb per volt (1 C/V). Typical capacitance values range from about 1 pF (10−12 F) to about 1 mF (10−3 F).

The capacitance is greater when there is a narrower separation between conductors and when the conductors have a larger surface area. In practice, the dielectric between the plates passes a small amount of leakage current and also has an electric field strength limit, known as the breakdown voltage. The conductors and leads introduce an undesired inductance and resistance.

Capacitors are widely used in electronic circuits for blocking direct current while allowing alternating current to pass. In analog filter networks, they smooth the output of power supplies. In resonant circuits they tune radios to particular frequencies. Inelectric power transmission systems, they stabilize voltage and power flow.

A solid state relay (SSR) is just what it sounds like; an IC that acts like a mechanical relay. They allow you to control high-voltage AC loads from lower voltage DC control circuitry. They accomplish this by using infrared light as the ‘contact,’ a solid-state relay SSR is really just an IR LED and a phototriac sealed up into a little box.

Solid state relays, have several advantages over mechanical relays. One such advantage is that they can be switched by a much lower voltage and at a much lower current than most mechanical relays. Also, because there’s no moving contacts, solid state relays can be switched much faster and for much longer periods without wearing out.
Input voltage: 5VDC, Maximum Output Current: 2A, Maximum Output Voltage: 240VAC
Input Voltage of Control Signal: 0-2.5V (low level state), the relay will be on; 3-5V (high level state), the relay will be off.
DC+: Connected to positive supply voltage (supply power according to relay voltage)
DC-: Connected to negative supply voltage
CH1:Signal triggering terminal of relay module
The meaning of high and low level:

Triggered at high level means a forward voltage exists between signal triggering terminal (CH1) and negative supply voltage. It generally connects positive supply voltage and triggering terminal together. When triggering terminal has positive supply voltage or reaches triggering voltage, the relay will pull in.

While triggered at low level means the voltage between the signal triggering terminal (CH1) and negative supply voltage is 0V, or the voltage at the triggering terminal is lower than positive supply voltage. If it lowers to a triggering voltage, the relay will pull in. It generally connects negative supply voltage and triggering terminal together.

blocks.text: When a low level is supplied to signal terminal of the solid state relay, the LED at the output terminal will light up. Otherwise, it will turn off. If a periodic high and low level is supplied to the signal terminal, you can see the LED will cycle between on and off.

Connect the signal terminal (CH1) of solid state relay to digital port 7 of the SunFounder Uno board, and connect an LED at the output terminal. Upload the following code, then you can see the LED cycle between on and off.

/********************************************** const int relayPin =7; //the Signal Pin of relay module attach to /**********************************************/ void setup() { pinMode(relayPin, OUTPUT); //initialize relay as an output } /***********************************************/ void loop() { digitalWrite(relayPin, LOW); //Close the relay delay(3000); //wait for 3 second digitalWrite(relayPin, HIGH); //disconnect the relay delay(2000); //wait for 2 second } //*************************************************/

blocks.text: PBS-33B 12mm Black Waterproof Momentary Push Button Switch 2-Pin

The PBS-33B 12mm Black Waterproof Momentary Push Button Switch is a compact and practical push button switch designed for applications that require a temporary control signal. This switch works as a momentary self-reset push button, meaning it turns ON only while the button is being pressed and automatically returns to OFF once the button is released.

This type of push button is ideal for electronic and electrical control applications where a short activation signal is needed rather than a maintained ON/OFF state. It can be used as a reset button, trigger button, relay activation input, access control button, test button, manual control input, or temporary signal switch in a wide range of projects.

The switch features a black round button head, compact plastic body, threaded panel-mount structure, metal fixing nut, and 2-pin terminals. Its 12mm mounting size makes it easy to install into panels, boxes, project enclosures, control boards, and custom equipment housings. The black button design gives it a clean and professional appearance, especially in dark-colored panels and compact control layouts.

The internal function is (ON)-OFF. In normal condition, the circuit is OFF. When the button is pressed, the contact closes and the circuit becomes ON. When the button is released, the contact opens again and the circuit returns to OFF. This makes it different from self-locking push buttons, which stay ON after pressing until pressed again.

The PBS-33B is suitable for low-current switching and control circuits. Although the switch is commonly listed with AC voltage ratings, it is recommended to use it mainly for control signals, relay inputs, low-current electronics, and similar applications. For motors, heaters, lamps, high-current circuits, or loads with high inrush current, it is better to use this switch as a control input for a relay, contactor, transistor driver, or control module instead of carrying the full load directly.

This product is especially useful in DIY electronics, home appliance controls, small machines, magnetic locks, access control panels, control boxes, test equipment, educational kits, and maintenance replacement applications.

مفتاح الضغط اللحظي الأسود مقاس 12 مللي هو مفتاح دائري صغير مخصص للتركيب على اللوحات والعلب الإلكترونية، ويستخدم في التطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى توصيل مؤقت أثناء الضغط فقط. هذا النوع يعمل بنظام الرجوع الذاتي، حيث يتم توصيل الدائرة عند الضغط على الزر، ثم تعود الدائرة إلى وضع الفصل تلقائيًا عند ترك الزر.

يتميز المفتاح بزر أسود دائري، جسم بلاستيك مدمج، قلاوظ للتركيب، صامولة معدنية للتثبيت، وطرفين للتوصيل. تصميمه البسيط يجعله مناسبًا للوحات التحكم الصغيرة، دوائر إعادة التشغيل، أزرار الاختبار، دوائر تشغيل الريلاي، أنظمة التحكم في الأقفال المغناطيسية، العلب الإلكترونية، ومشروعات الإلكترونيات التعليمية.

وظيفة هذا المفتاح هي توصيل أثناء الضغط ثم فصل عند ترك الزر. في الوضع الطبيعي تكون الدائرة مفصولة، وعند الضغط على الزر يتم غلق نقاط التلامس فتعمل الدائرة، وبمجرد ترك الزر تفتح نقاط التلامس مرة أخرى. لذلك فهو ليس مفتاح تثبيت ذاتي ولا يظل في وضع التشغيل بعد الضغط.

هذا المنتج مناسب بشكل خاص للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى إشارة قصيرة أو أمر تشغيل مؤقت، مثل زر إعادة تشغيل، زر فتح مؤقت، زر اختبار، زر تنبيه، أو زر تحكم في ريلاي. كما أن اللون الأسود يعطي شكلًا أنيقًا ومناسبًا للوحات الاحترافية والأجهزة ذات الواجهة الداكنة.

رغم أن المفتاح له تصنيف كهربائي مناسب لدوائر التحكم، يفضل استخدامه في الدوائر منخفضة التيار أو كإشارة تحكم فقط. لا يفضل توصيل الأحمال الكبيرة مباشرة على المفتاح، مثل المحركات أو السخانات أو الأحمال التي تسحب تيارًا عاليًا عند بداية التشغيل. في هذه الحالات، الأفضل استخدام المفتاح لتشغيل ريلاي أو دائرة قيادة مناسبة.

blocks.text: EU Universal 18650 Li-ion Battery Charger 1 Cell

The EU Universal 18650 Li-ion Battery Charger 1 Cell provides a simple and convenient way to charge one rechargeable 18650 lithium-ion battery. It connects directly to a compatible AC wall outlet and does not require a separate adapter or USB charging cable.

Its compact single-slot design makes it suitable for home use, electronics workshops, laboratories, and DIY projects. In addition, the spring-loaded battery holder keeps the cell securely positioned during charging.

A rechargeable 18650 lithium-ion cell normally has a nominal voltage of 3.6V or 3.7V. When fully charged, its voltage reaches approximately 4.2V. Therefore, this charger provides a suitable 4.2V charging output for one compatible Li-ion cell.

The EU Universal 18650 Li-ion Battery Charger 1 Cell has an approximate charging current of 450mA, according to the listed product version. However, the exact output should always be confirmed from the specification printed on the supplied charger because electrical ratings can vary slightly between production batches.

Charging time depends on the battery capacity, remaining charge, age, condition, and internal resistance. For example, a healthy 2000mAh cell may require approximately five to six hours to charge from a low level.
Direct connection to an AC outlet
Suitable for charging spare and replacement cells
Ideal for home, workshop, and laboratory use
How to Use the 18650 Battery Charger 1 Cell
First, inspect the battery and make sure that its insulating wrapper is not damaged. Do not charge a swollen, leaking, rusted, overheated, or physically damaged cell.

Insert the 18650 battery into the slot while following the positive and negative polarity markings. The positive terminal normally points toward the charger’s marked positive contact. Never force the battery into the holder.

After installing the cell correctly, connect the charger to a suitable wall outlet. The LED indicates the charging status according to the charger version. Once charging is complete, disconnect the charger from the outlet before removing the battery.
This single-cell charger can be used for rechargeable 18650 batteries installed in:

This charger is intended for one standard rechargeable 18650 Li-ion cell. Compatibility with extra-long protected 18650 batteries depends on the physical length of the charging slot. Therefore, do not force an oversized battery into the spring-loaded holder.
The charger is not suitable for disposable batteries, AA or AAA Ni-MH batteries, 9V batteries, Li-Po pouch cells, lead-acid batteries, or multi-cell lithium battery packs.
Always verify the battery polarity before connecting the charger to AC power. Reversed installation can damage the charger or battery and may create a safety hazard.

Place the charger on a dry, ventilated, and heat-resistant surface. Keep it away from water, direct sunlight, flammable materials, children, and excessive heat. Furthermore, do not cover the charger while it is operating.

Do not leave lithium-ion batteries charging unattended or overnight. Disconnect the charger after use and store charged cells safely away from loose metal objects that could short-circuit their terminals.

blocks.text: MG995 Servo Motor Tower Pro 180 Degree (Full Metal Gear)

The MG995 Servo Motor from Tower Pro is a robust and high-torque servo designed for precision control in a variety of mechanical and electronic applications. Featuring a rotation range of approximately 180 degrees, this servo is ideal for tasks that require accurate positioning, such as in robotic arms, RC vehicles, and automation systems.

What sets the MG995 apart is its full metal gear construction, which includes strong brass and steel components. This durable gear system ensures long-lasting performance and reliability under continuous load and stress. The metal gears also provide resistance against wear and tear, making the motor suitable for demanding environments where plastic-geared servos might fail.

The servo operates within a voltage range of 4.8V to 7.2V, and can produce up to 12 kg·cm of torque at 6V, which is more than enough for most mid-level hobby and engineering projects. It also features dual ball bearings, which enhance smooth operation and reduce internal friction, improving both responsiveness and lifespan.

The MG995 uses a PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) signal for control, with a standard pulse range of 1 ms to 2 ms determining the angle of rotation. It’s compatible with microcontrollers such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and most RC receivers, making integration into projects simple and straightforward. The 3-wire connector (orange for signal, red for VCC, and brown for ground) ensures easy and universal connectivity.

Measuring 40.7 mm × 19.7 mm × 42.9 mm and weighing about 55 grams, the MG995 is compact enough to fit in tight spaces while offering high performance. Whether you’re building a robotic hand, a camera gimbal, or a steering system for an RC car, the MG995 offers a reliable, high-torque, and durable solution at an affordable price.

makers-547798.summary: UNI-T UT336E Digital Manifold Gauge: 162+ refrigerants, 4 test modes, superheat/subcooling calc, wireless app & IP54 for HVAC pros.

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT336E Digital Manifold Gauge (also called AC Diagnoser) facilitates the installation, debugging and maintenance of refrigeration and heat pump systems. It accurately measures high- and low-side pressures.

The device combines a 3.5-inch TFT color screen with an analog-dial style UI for clear measurement display and status indication. Evaporation and condensation (saturation) temperatures are automatically calculated from the built-in refrigerant database at the current pressures, while T1/T2 surface temperatures are measured by the wireless clamps (SH = T1 − EV; SC = CO − T2).

Four measurement modes cover the entire repair workflow: Refrigeration, Evacuation, Pressure Test and Delta T. In Pressure Test mode the device records the initial pressure and the scale turns yellow if the system leaks. In Evacuation mode it displays operation time and vacuum percentage.

With built-in parameters for 162 refrigerants (updatable via mobile app), A2L refrigerant compatibility, audible/visual alarms, temperature compensation for pressure-holding tests, and wireless remote monitoring via the iENV mobile app (real-time data viewing and report export), the UT336E is a complete diagnostic solution for HVAC/R technicians. Its IP54 housing, 2 m drop protection, metal hanging hook and rechargeable 5200 mAh lithium battery with Type-C charging make it suitable for harsh field environments.

Built-in safety features include X-ray protection, supply voltage monitoring, lock/unlock detection, blanking control, and output shutdown functions. The TDA9105 also provides extensive geometry adjustments such as pincushion correction, trapezoid correction, side-pin balance, parallelogram correction, vertical size, vertical position, S-correction, and dynamic focus generation for high-quality CRT image reproduction.

blocks.text: MC14174BCP HEX D-Type Flip Flop IC 5V 5µA DIP-16

MC14174BCP HEX D-Type Flip Flop IC 5V 5µA DIP-16 that contains six independent D flip-flops integrated into a single DIP-16 package. All six flip-flops share a common clock input and an asynchronous active-low reset input. Data present at each D input is transferred to its corresponding Q output on the positive-going edge of the clock signal, making the device ideal for sequential logic and digital storage applications.

Built using complementary MOS technology, the MC14174BCP offers low power consumption, high noise immunity, and a wide operating voltage range. The device includes buffered inputs and outputs along with input protection circuitry for improved reliability. It is functionally equivalent to the classic 74174 TTL device while providing the advantages of CMOS operation, making it suitable for industrial, educational, embedded, and digital control systems.

The Universal 6.3mm Silicone Nozzle Protection Sleeve is a replaceable accessory designed for use with manual desoldering pumps. It fits over the front nozzle of the solder sucker, creating a protective layer between the original pump tip and the hot soldering area. This helps reduce direct exposure of the nozzle to heat, solder residue, and repeated contact during PCB repair and component removal.

During normal desoldering work, the front of the pump is repeatedly positioned close to the soldering iron and molten solder. The silicone sleeve acts as a sacrificial protective section, allowing the inexpensive sleeve to take most of this wear instead of the desoldering pump nozzle itself.

شاحن بطاريات ليثيوم ذكي خانتين جي ٨٦ سي ٢ بكابل تايب سي هو شاحن صغير وعملي مخصص لشحن بطاريات الليثيوم الأسطوانية القابلة للشحن ذات الجهد الاسمي ٣٫٧ فولت. يدعم الشاحن مقاسات متعددة مثل بطاريات ١٨٦٥٠ و١٤٥٠٠ و١٦٣٤٠ و١٨٣٥٠ و١٨٥٠٠ ومقاسات أخرى متوافقة، لذلك يعتبر اختيارًا مناسبًا للكشافات والأجهزة المحمولة ومشروعات الإلكترونيات وورش الصيانة وتجهيز البطاريات الاحتياطية.

هذا الموديل يعتمد على منفذ تايب سي مع كابل منفصل، وليس كابلًا مدمجًا داخل جسم الشاحن. هذا يعطي مرونة أكبر في الاستخدام، حيث يمكن توصيله بمصادر طاقة متعددة مثل شاحن الموبايل أو الحاسوب أو الباور بنك أو شاحن السيارة أو مقبس شحن مناسب. التصميم ذو الخانتين يسمح بشحن بطارية واحدة أو بطاريتين في نفس الوقت، مع مؤشر ضوئي مستقل لكل خانة لتوضيح حالة الشحن.

يوفر الشاحن خرج شحن ٤٫٢ فولت، وهو الجهد المناسب لاكتمال شحن بطاريات الليثيوم ذات الجهد الاسمي ٣٫٧ فولت. كما يتميز بمؤشرات ضوئية واضحة؛ اللون الأحمر يدل على أن البطارية قيد الشحن، واللون الأخضر يدل على اكتمال الشحن أو وضع الاستعداد حسب حالة الخانة.

يستخدم هذا النوع في الأجهزة التي تعمل بالبطاريات، ومشروعات الهواة، والدوائر الصغيرة، وأنظمة الإضاءة البسيطة، وأعمال الصيانة التي تحتاج إلى مفتاح تشغيل وإيقاف صغير وسهل التركيب. حجمه الصغير يجعله مناسبًا للتركيب داخل العلب واللوحات الضيقة مع بقاء ذراع التحريك ظاهرًا وسهل الاستخدام.

blocks.text: The Ring Ferrite Core 27×14×11mm is a compact toroidal magnetic core made from ferrite material, designed to influence and control magnetic fields in electrical and electronic circuits. Ferrite is a ceramic-like magnetic material with high electrical resistance, which makes it ideal for minimizing unwanted eddy current losses at high frequencies. The toroidal or ring shape provides a closed magnetic path that enhances magnetic coupling and reduces magnetic leakage, making this core especially effective for inductive components and noise suppression.

In practical use, this ring ferrite core serves as the backbone of various inductive elements such as chokes, filters, and transformers. When wire is wound around the core or a conductor is passed through its center, the core increases inductance and helps filter out high-frequency interference from signals or power lines. Its physical dimensions an outer diameter of approximately 27 mm, an inner diameter near 14 mm, and a height of about 11 mm make it well-suited for DIY electronics, power supplies, and communication circuits where space is limited but electromagnetic performance matters.

The material and size balance electrical performance with mechanical robustness. Ferrite cores like this are inherently stable and resilient, capable of operating across a broad temperature range without significant changes in magnetic behavior. They are widely available and inexpensive, which makes them a go-to choice for both hobbyists and professional designers working on noise reduction, signal conditioning, or transformer design.

makers-490070.summary: Manufacturer Texas Instruments Mfr. Part # TL16C750FN Package FN – 44-pin PLCC Datasheet TL16C750FN Description The TL16C750FN is a 3.3V/5V UART with 64-byte FIFOs

blocks.text: TL16C750FN – 3.3V/5V Single UART with 64-Byte FIFOs and Auto-Flow Control SMD IC

The TL16C750FN is an Asynchronous Communications Element (ACE), commonly known as a UART, which serves as a crucial interface between a parallel data bus and a serial communication channel. It performs serial-to-parallel conversion on data received from peripheral devices and parallel-to-serial conversion on data transmitted from its central processing unit (CPU). This device is a functional upgrade of earlier models, maintaining full software compatibility while introducing advanced features to reduce CPU overhead and enhance data integrity in serial communication systems.

A key advancement of the TL16C750FN is its integrated buffering system. It incorporates 64-byte FIFOs (First-In, First-Out) for both the receiver and transmitter sections. These FIFOs temporarily store data, allowing the CPU to handle data in blocks rather than on a character-by-character basis. This buffering significantly reduces the number of interrupts the CPU must service, thereby lowering software overhead and increasing overall system efficiency and performance in data-intensive applications.

To further optimize data flow and prevent data loss, the TL16C750FN features a programmable auto-flow control mechanism. This system is composed of auto-RTS (Request To Send) and auto-CTS (Clear To Send). Auto-RTS automatically desserts the RTS signal when the receiver FIFO is nearing capacity, signaling the transmitting device to pause. Conversely, auto-CTS halts the transmitter if the CTS signal is inactive, indicating the receiving device is not ready. This hardware-managed handshake eliminates overrun errors without CPU intervention.

blocks.text: KYORITSU KEW 4300 Simplified Earth Tester (Made In THAILAND)

The KYORITSU KEW 4300 Simplified Earth Tester (Made In THAILAND) is a handheld, simplified earth resistance tester designed for quick, two-pole measurements using existing earth electrodes (e.g. buried water pipes or building lightning rods). Its compact body houses a rotary range switch and an integral LED work‐light that automatically adapts to ambient brightness, making it ideal for field use in dimly lit areas.

Employing a constant-current fall-of-potential method, the tester injects a small AC current (≈1.4 mA at 825 Hz on the 200 Ω range; ≈0.7 mA at 825 Hz on the 2000 Ω range) between the H(C) and E terminals, then measures the voltage drop to calculate “Rx + re.” The result earth resistance plus any existing earth electrode resistance is displayed instantly; deduct any known “re” to obtain true “Rx”.

Built to withstand indoor environments up to 2000 m altitude, the KEW 4300 features a protective finger-guard, glow-in-the-dark TEST button, and a warning buzzer that sounds below 100 Ω. Its backlit LCD auto-shuts after 2 minutes, and the instrument powers off after 10 minutes of inactivity, preserving two AA alkaline cells. A live-circuit LED warns if line voltage exceeds 30 V during resistance measurement.

blocks.text: SL608N Linear Slide Potentiometer 10KOhm Travel Distance 60mm

The Linear Potentiometer has a similar function as the rotary potentiometer, but instead of the semi-circular resistance, there will be a linear resistor here with a sliding contact. The two ends of the linear resistor are connected across the source or input voltage, the output is taken between the sliding contact and any end of the linear resistor. The linear pots are commonly used for measuring the voltage across a branch of a circuit, for measuring the internal resistance of a battery cell, and also for comparing a battery cell with a standard cell.

The slide pot is a single linear slider potentiometer which is also called the fader. The fader is constructed with conductive plastic. These are mostly used for audio applications and single-channel control or measurement of distance.

blocks.text: Note: The PIC12C508 Microcontroller datasheet can be found at the bottom of this page.

The PIC16F676 microcontroller belongs to the 12C series of Microchip microcontrollers. These controllers are compact low cost 8-pin controller with internal oscillator (4MHz) that can be used in compact and portable applications. The control has an operating voltage between 2.5V to 5.5V and supports one internal 8-bit timer. It also supports on-board programming (ICSP) and comes with safety features like Brown-out Detection, Watchdog Timer (WDT) etc making it reliable and suitable for industrial applications also.

It is well suited for low speed, low cost designs to perform basic arithmetic or logic functions. It is also suited for battery applications since it supports power saving sleep mode and wake-up from sleep functions. However as on date the controller is discontinued by Microchip and has been replaced by the advanced PIC12F508 from the 12F series controllers.

PIC microcontroller can be programmed with different software’s that is available in the market. There are people who still use Assembly language to program PIC MCUs. The below details is for most advanced and common software and compiler that has been developed by Microchip itself.

In order to program the PIC microcontroller we will need an IDE (Integrated Development Environment), where the programming takes place. A compiler, where our program gets converted into MCU readable form called HEX files. An IPE (Integrated Programming Environment), which is used to dump our hex file into our PIC MCUs.

Microchip has given all these three software for free. They can be downloaded directly from their official page. I have also provided the link for your convenience. Once downloaded install them on your computer. If you have any problem doing so you can post them on the comment below.

To dump or upload our code into PIC, we will need a device called PICkit 3. The PICkit 3 programmer/debugger is a simple, low-cost in-circuit debugger that is controlled by a PC running MPLAB IDE (v8.20 or greater) software on a Windows platform. The PICkit 3 programmer/debugger is an integral part of the development engineer’s tool suite. In addition to this we will also need other hardware like Perf board or breadboard, Soldering station, PIC ICs, Crystal oscillators, capacitors etc.

makers-337874.summary: EU to US plug adapter: lets you plug European-round two-pin plugs into U.S. flat two-prong outlets; compact, safe, no voltage conversion supplied.

blocks.text: The EU to US plug adapter is a compact device designed to allow travelers and electronics users to connect European-style plugs (usually the round two-pin type) into American safety sockets that use two flat parallel prongs. It acts purely as a physical interface, enabling the prongs on your European power cable to align with the shape and layout required by U.S. outlets, without altering how your plug or outlet functions otherwise. The body of the adapter is typically molded plastic or similar insulating material, housing metal contacts inside which transfer current between the mismatched plug styles.

Inside this adapter, the internal conductors are shaped to bridge the geometric difference between round and flat pin designs. These conductors are often made of copper or copper alloy to ensure good electrical connection. There is usually a snug fit both where the European plug pins insert and where the U.S. flat prongs plug into the wall socket. The adapter is small just large enough to surround the metal parts safely and provide mechanical support, but designed to remain lightweight and convenient for portability.

Visually, the adapter tends to look simple: two round holes (for EU plug pins) on one side; two flat blades or prongs (for U.S.) on the opposite. Its appearance is utilitarian: compact form, often white or black, sometimes with slight markings or symbols indicating input/output and safety certification. Because it’s a bridge rather than a converter, there are no bulky components inside for voltage transformation. It must be used with devices that already support the local voltage range, otherwise supplying them could damage the device or cause unsafe operation.

blocks.text: If you want to add some visual output to your Arduino projects, you’ll need a display. If you need only a little to display, the LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display is a quite good solution.

This is LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display that provides a simple and cost-effective solution for adding a 16×2 White on RGB Liquid Crystal Display into your project. The display is 16 character by 2 line display that has a very clear and high contrast white text upon a blue background/backlight.

This is the great blue backlight LCD display. It is fantastic for Arduino-based projects. This LCD1602 Parallel LCD Display with Yellow Backlight is very easy to interface with Arduino or Other Microcontrollers.
The values shown on the display can be either simple text or numerical values read by the sensors, such as temperature or pressure, or even the number of cycles that the Arduino is performing.

One thing to consider is you’ll waste about 8 Pins on your Arduino for the display to get working. Luckily there exists an I2C adapter that you can solder right onto the pins of the display. So all you need to connect are the I2C pins, which show a good library and little of coding. We have the same LCD module with a pre-assembled I2C adapter, click on the name below to check it

باور بانك هيريجو دي بي كيه اتش ار ٠١٠ بسعة ١٠٠٠٠ ملي أمبير بكابلات مدمجة وشحن متزامن

باور بانك هيريجو دي بي كيه اتش ار ٠١٠ هو شاحن متنقل عملي مصمم لمن يريد باور بانك بكابلات مدمجة لتقليل الحاجة لحمل كابلات منفصلة. يأتي بسعة ١٠٠٠٠ ملي أمبير، وخرج إجمالي ١٠ وات، مع كابلات مدمجة متعددة تناسب أجهزة مختلفة، بالإضافة إلى مؤشرات ضوئية لمعرفة مستوى البطارية بسهولة.

هذا الموديل مناسب للاستخدام اليومي في الشغل أو الدراسة أو السفر أو أثناء التنقل. أهم ما يميزه هو وجود أكثر من كابل مدمج داخل جسم الباور بانك، حيث يدعم توصيل أجهزة تعمل بتايب سي ولايتنينج وميكرو، بالإضافة إلى مخرج عادي، مما يجعله حل مريح عند شحن أكثر من نوع جهاز بدون فوضى كابلات.

طبقًا للصور والبيانات المرسلة، يدعم المنتج الشحن المتزامن حتى أربعة منافذ، مع الالتزام بأن إجمالي الخرج الأقصى هو ٥ فولت ٢ أمبير، أي ١٠ وات. لذلك فهو باور بانك للشحن القياسي وليس شاحن سريع بقدرة عالية. وجود مؤشرات البطارية الضوئية يساعد على معرفة مستوى الشحن المتبقي، حيث تمثل لمبة واحدة حوالي ٢٥ بالمئة، ولمبتان حوالي ٥٠ بالمئة، وثلاث لمبات حوالي ٧٥ بالمئة، وأربع لمبات حوالي ١٠٠ بالمئة.

توضح الصور أيضًا أن التصميم يحتوي على أماكن مخصصة للكابلات، وستاند صغير مدمج يمكن استخدامه لحمل الموبايل أثناء الشحن أو مشاهدة محتوى على المكتب. الشكل الخارجي أسود بنقشة عملية، مناسب للحمل والاستخدام اليومي مع مراعاة حدود قدرة الشحن.
سعة ١٠٠٠٠ ملي أمبير: مناسبة كمصدر طاقة احتياطي للموبايل والإكسسوارات في الاستخدام اليومي.

blocks.text: Mecanum Omni Wheel 60mm Set Right + Left for Yellow TT Motor (2pcs/set )

The Mecanum Omni Wheel 60mm Set Right + Left for Yellow TT Motor is a practical wheel pair designed for small robot cars and DIY smart vehicle projects that need movement in more than just forward and backward directions. This set includes one right wheel and one left wheel, allowing the chassis to achieve smoother multidirectional motion when used in a compatible drive arrangement.

These wheels use the mecanum / omni wheel concept, where multiple angled rollers are mounted around the outer circumference of each wheel. This design allows the robot to move laterally, rotate more freely, and perform advanced movement patterns by changing the direction and speed of each motor. That makes them very suitable for educational robotics, motion experiments, smart car platforms, and compact mobile robot systems.

This version is the 60mm-K type, and the wheel body is marked 60mm-K. The set comes as 2 pieces only: one right-hand wheel and one left-hand wheel. It also includes 2 plastic couplers to fit the common yellow TT motor, plus 2 screws for mounting. The motor itself is not included.

The wheel structure is designed to provide flexible movement and better maneuverability in tight spaces. It can help a robot perform side movement, angled movement, and turning motions more smoothly than a standard wheel. Because the rollers reduce sideways resistance, the platform can move in multiple directions without needing to turn its full body first.

Each wheel has an outer diameter of 60mm and a thickness around 24mm to 28mm depending on how it is measured across the body and roller profile. The wheel is suitable for compact robotics projects and light mobile platforms. It is a useful option for students, hobbyists, and developers building mecanum-based motion systems using TT gear motors.

هذا المنتج مصنوع من فولاذ مطلي بالنيكل، وهو مناسب للاستخدام في عمليات اللحام النقطي الخاصة بتجميع البطاريات، سواء في المشروعات اليدوية أو أعمال الصيانة أو تجهيز حزم البطاريات للأجهزة المحمولة وأنظمة الطاقة الاحتياطية والتطبيقات الإلكترونية المختلفة. كما أن تصميم 2P يساعد على تسريع العمل داخل حزمة البطارية ويُسهّل ترتيب الخلايا أثناء التركيب.

بفضل السُمك 0.15 مم والعرض 27 مم والتباعد 20.25 مم، فإن هذا الشريط مناسب للعديد من تطبيقات تجميع خلايا 18650. كما أن الطول 1 متر يمنح المستخدم مرونة جيدة لتنفيذ أكثر من مشروع أو لإجراء أعمال صيانة متعددة باستخدام نفس القطعة.

يُستخدم هذا الشريط بشكل شائع مع ماكينات لحام البطاريات لربط الخلايا على التوالي أو التوازي حسب تصميم حزمة البطارية. وهو مناسب للفنيين والهواة ومراكز الصيانة وكل من يعمل في تجميع البطاريات أو إعادة تأهيلها.

Features 75W dissipation, 25nC gate charge, and up to 2.5Ω RDS(on). موسفت قدرة بقناة إن بجهد 600 فولت وتيار 4 أمبير في عبوة تي أو 220 مناسب لدوائر التبديل عالية الجهد مثل مزودات الطاقة التبديلية والمحولات، مع قدرة تبديد 75 وات وشحنة بوابة 25 نانوكولوم.

blocks.text: The SSP4N60 is a high-voltage N-Channel Power MOSFET designed for efficient switching in power electronics. With a 600V drain-source rating and up to 4A continuous drain current, it’s a solid choice for offline SMPS stages, DC-DC converters, and general high-voltage switching applications.

This MOSFET comes in a TO-220 package that supports practical heat-sinking for higher power operation. It features a maximum power dissipation of 75W (with proper thermal conditions) and a maximum junction temperature of 150°C, making it suitable for demanding designs.

For gate drive and switching behavior, the device offers a total gate charge (Qg) of 25nC, supporting reasonable switching speed and driver requirements. The rise time is up to 150ns, while the output capacitance (Coss) is 40pF, helping reduce switching losses in many high-voltage converter topologies. The gate threshold voltage (VGS(th)) is up to 4.5V, and the MOSFET is rated for ±20V gate-source voltage (VGS).

On the conduction side, the maximum RDS(on) is 2.5Ω, which is typical for 600V MOSFETs in this current class and should be considered when estimating conduction losses at your operating current and temperature.
موسفت قدرة قناة إن 600 فولت 4 أمبير عبوة تي أو 220 (SSP4N60)

إس إس بي 4 إن 60 (SSP4N60) هو ترانزستور قدرة من نوع موسفت بقناة إن، مخصص لتطبيقات التبديل عالي الجهد في دوائر إلكترونيات القدرة. يتميز بقدرة تحمل جهد حتى 600 فولت بين المصرف والمصدر، مع تيار مصرف أقصى 4 أمبير، مما يجعله مناسبًا لدوائر مزوّدات الطاقة التبديلية، ومحولات التيار، ومراحل التبديل في كثير من تطبيقات القدرة.

يأتي هذا الموسفت في عبوة تي أو 220 المناسبة للتركيب مع مشتت حراري عند الحاجة، ويدعم قدرة تبديد تصل إلى 75 وات وفق شروط التبريد المناسبة. كما أن أقصى درجة حرارة للوصلة الداخلية 150 درجة مئوية لتوافق ظروف التشغيل القاسية نسبيًا في تطبيقات القدرة.

من ناحية قيادة البوابة وسلوك التبديل، يمتلك شحنة بوابة كلية 25 نانوكولوم لتوازن جيد بين سرعة التبديل ومتطلبات دائرة القيادة. كذلك يصل زمن الصعود إلى 150 نانوثانية كحد أقصى، وتبلغ سعة الخرج 40 بيكوفاراد بما يساعد على تحسين أداء التبديل في كثير من الدوائر عالية الجهد. كما أن جهد عتبة البوابة يصل إلى 4.5 فولت كحد أقصى، مع تحمل جهد بين البوابة والمصدر حتى 20 فولت.
أما في حالة التوصيل، فإن مقاومة التوصيل بين المصرف والمصدر تصل إلى 2.5 أوم كحد أقصى، وهي قيمة شائعة ضمن فئة موسفت 600 فولت بهذا التيار، ويُفضَّل مراعاتها عند حساب الفقد الحراري أثناء التشغيل.

The 20N60 N-Channel MOSFET is a high-voltage power transistor built for switching applications up to 600V with a continuous drain current of 20A. It is commonly used in circuits that require fast switching, high efficiency, and strong performance under thermal stress—such as power converters, motor drive stages, and switching power supplies.

Thanks to its low RDS(on) and solid avalanche ruggedness, the 20N60 helps reduce conduction losses and improves overall power stage efficiency. Its design supports stable operation in demanding conditions, making it a dependable option for both industrial and consumer high-voltage switching circuits.

blocks.text: QianLi Macaron Max Integrated Spot Welder

QianLi Macaron Max is a portable, integrated double-pulse spot welding machine designed for precision battery work and micro-fabrication. The all-in-one chassis combines a color control screen, an adjustable clamp base, and a heat-resistant silicone workpad—so you don’t need extra fixtures. With 650A peak output, dual-pulse control (preheat + main pulse), and a 4,000 mAh high-C internal battery, it delivers stable, repeatable welds on nickel tabs and small packs, whether you’re repairing smartphone batteries (iPhone 11–15 Pro Max fixture option), assembling 18650 cells, or tackling delicate sensors and nickel strips.

تأتي QianLi Macaron Max كـ آلة لحام نقطي محمولة مدمجة بميزة النبض المزدوج مخصصة لأعمال البطاريات الدقيقة والتجميعات الصغيرة. تجمع الهيكلية الكل-في-واحد بين شاشة ملوّنة للتحكم، قاعدة تثبيت قابلة للضبط، ومنطقة عمل سيليكون مقاومة للحرارة—بدون الحاجة لملحقات إضافية. بقدرة ذروة حتى 650 أمبير، وتحكم نبضي مزدوج (تسخين تمهيدي + نبضة رئيسية)، وبطارية داخلية 4000 mAh عالية المعدّل (C)، توفّر لحامات ثابتة ومتكررة على شرائط النيكل والباكات الصغيرة، سواء لإصلاح بطاريات الهواتف (خيار قوالب بطاريات iPhone 11–15 Pro Max)، أو تركيب خلايا 18650، أو أعمال الشرائط الدقيقة.

blocks.text: Handheld RFID Card Copier Reader Writer 125KHz with 3 Blank ID Tags

Handheld RFID Card Copier Reader Writer 125KHz with 3 Blank ID Tags is a compact portable device designed for reading and writing compatible low-frequency RFID ID cards and tags. It is commonly used for duplicating supported 125KHz ID cards such as EM4100 and EM410X type cards onto compatible writable blank tags such as T5577, T5557, or 5200 cards, depending on the original card type and compatibility.

This device does not copy all RFID cards. Some access cards are encrypted, protected, or use unsupported frequencies or chip types, and they cannot be copied using this 125KHz copier. The customer must confirm that the card is a compatible 125KHz ID card and that it can be copied before purchasing. If the card uses encryption, high-frequency 13.56MHz technology, MIFARE encryption, HID encrypted formats, or another unsupported chip, this device will not clone it.

This handheld RFID copier is built for simple field use without needing a computer or software. It includes two main buttons, one for reading the original card and another for writing the copied ID to a compatible blank tag. The device has LED indicators for power, successful reading, writing status, and busy operation, making the process easy to follow.

The compact ABS body is lightweight and comfortable to hold. Its portable size makes it suitable for technicians, access control maintenance, ID tag backup, and general RFID testing. It works using two AAA batteries, making it convenient for on-site use without requiring external power. Please note that batteries are not included.

The device is intended for copying supported unencrypted 125KHz RFID ID cards only. It can be used with compatible blank tags supplied with the product or other compatible writable cards. It is not a universal copier and must not be used for unauthorized access, illegal duplication, or copying cards that you do not own or do not have permission to duplicate.

جهاز نسخ وقراءة وكتابة كروت RFID 125KHz مع 3 تاجات فارغة هو جهاز محمول عملي لقراءة ونسخ بعض أنواع كروت وبطاقات RFID منخفضة التردد 125KHz، وكتابة نفس الكود على تاج أو كارت فارغ متوافق. الجهاز مناسب للاستخدام في أعمال الصيانة والاختبار ونسخ الكروت المتوافقة بغرض عمل نسخة احتياطية مصرح بها.

الجهاز لا ينسخ كل كروت RFID. يوجد كروت مشفرة أو محمية أو تعمل بتردد مختلف أو شريحة غير مدعومة، وهذه الكروت لن يتم نسخها على هذا الجهاز. يجب على العميل التأكد قبل الشراء أن الكارت المطلوب نسخه هو كارت ID بتردد 125KHz وغير مشفر ومتوافق مع الجهاز. الكروت المشفرة أو كروت 13.56MHz أو كروت NFC / MIFARE أو أي كروت حماية متقدمة غالبًا لن تعمل مع هذا الجهاز.

يتميز هذا الجهاز بسهولة الاستخدام لأنه لا يحتاج إلى كمبيوتر أو برنامج خارجي. يحتوي على زر للقراءة وزر للكتابة، مع مؤشرات LED توضح حالة التشغيل والقراءة والكتابة والنجاح والانشغال. يتم وضع الكارت الأصلي المتوافق بالقرب من منطقة الهوائي، ثم الضغط على زر READ لقراءة الكود، وبعد ذلك يتم وضع تاج أو كارت فارغ متوافق والضغط على زر WRITE لكتابة الكود عليه.

الجهاز مصنوع من خامة ABS خفيفة، وتصميمه محمول ومناسب للاستخدام داخل الورشة أو في الموقع. يعمل ببطاريتين AAA، مما يجعله سهل الحمل ولا يحتاج إلى مصدر طاقة خارجي أثناء العمل. البطاريات غير مرفقة مع المنتج.

blocks.text: HC-12 433MHz SI4438 Long-Range Wireless Serial UART Transceiver Module

The HC-12 is a compact wireless serial communication module designed for transparent UART data transmission between microcontrollers, development boards, embedded systems, and other TTL serial devices. This version uses the Silicon Labs Si4438 RF transceiver together with the STMicroelectronics STM8S003F3P6 microcontroller.

The module operates across the 433.4MHz to 473.0MHz frequency range and supports up to 100 selectable communication channels with 400kHz channel spacing. It provides a maximum transmission power of up to 100mW or 20dBm and can achieve long-distance communication in open areas when suitable antennas, settings, and power conditions are used.

The 150pF 50V ceramic capacitor is a small through-hole capacitor used for signal filtering, noise suppression and high-frequency circuits. Ceramic capacitors are non-polarised, so they can be fitted either way round, and they work well at high frequencies.
RC low-pass filters that remove high-frequency noise from signal and sensor lines.
Op-amp compensation across a feedback resistor.
Oscillator, RF and timing circuits that need a small capacitance.

A 10KΩ resistor in series with a signal and this 150pF capacitor to GND form a low-pass filter with a cut-off of f = 1 ÷ (2πRC): 1 ÷ (2π × 10KΩ × 150pF) ≈ 106 kHz. Slow signals pass, while fast spikes and RF noise are reduced.
Keep the working voltage comfortably below the 50V rating.
Keep the leads short in high-frequency and crystal circuits; long leads add inductance and stray capacitance.
Small ceramic capacitors can be marked with a code instead of the value, so read the code as shown above.

blocks.text: The MAX9814 Microphone Amplifier Module with Auto-Gain Control (AGC) is a popular audio amplification module for use with microcontrollers like Arduino. It’s designed to amplify audio signals from a microphone while automatically adjusting the gain to ensure consistent output levels, even when the input signal varies in volume. This feature makes it especially useful for applications where the input sound may vary, such as voice recognition, audio sensing, or other sound-related projects.

The MAX9814 automatically adjusts the microphone’s gain based on the input signal’s strength. If the sound is quiet, the amplifier boosts the signal; if the sound is loud, the amplifier reduces its gain to avoid distortion.
The module has an integrated electret microphone, which converts sound into an analog electrical signal.
Designed with a low-noise preamp, the module provides clean amplification of audio signals.
Although the AGC does most of the work, there is an option to manually adjust the gain using a potentiometer if desired.
The module outputs an analog signal that can be fed directly into an analog input pin on an Arduino or other microcontroller.
It typically operates on a voltage range of 2.7V to 5.5V, making it compatible with most microcontrollers, including Arduino boards running on 5V or 3.3V.
The module typically has the following pins:
GAIN: Optional pin for external gain control (some versions include a potentiometer or jumper for manual gain adjustment)
VCC connects to the 5V (or 3.3V, depending on your module) pin on the Arduino.
GND connects to the GND pin on the Arduino.
OUT connects to one of the analog input pins on the Arduino, like A0.
Below is an example sketch to read the microphone signal from the MAX9814 using an Arduino and print the values to the serial monitor:
The analogRead() function reads the analog signal from the microphone output. The value will vary based on the sound pressure level (volume) captured by the microphone.
The Arduino can process the data from the microphone to detect sound events, measure the sound intensity, or even use it for speech recognition or sound-activated systems.
Sound-activated lights or devices: For example, turning on an LED or triggering an action when a certain sound level is detected.
Voice recognition systems: Capturing audio input for voice-activated systems.
Sound level monitoring: Detecting ambient noise levels for applications like smart homes or noise-sensitive environments.
Audio projects: Amplifying sound for audio input in a variety of projects.
The output of the MAX9814 will be an analog signal, and the Arduino’s ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter) will convert this signal into a digital value (range from 0 to 1023).
To get the best results, keep the microphone module’s microphone within a reasonable distance from the sound source.
Depending on your application, you might want to apply filters or smoothing techniques to the raw data to reduce noise or fluctuations in the reading.
By using the MAX9814 with AGC, you can create more consistent sound-based interactions with Arduino, even in environments with variable background noise.

blocks.text: Package Type: Radial (leads extend from the bottom for through-hole mounting)
Temperature Range: Commonly -40°C to +85°C or up to +105°C (depending on the manufacturer)
ESR (Equivalent Series Resistance): Typically low, as specified by the manufacturer, and it affects the capacitor’s performance in high-frequency applications.
Leakage Current: Low leakage, measured at rated voltage after a set period (typically within manufacturer’s specification).
Life Expectancy: 1000 to 5000 hours at rated voltage and temperature, depending on the specific type and manufacturer.
Polarity: Polarized, so correct polarity must be observed during installation. The positive lead is typically marked (e.g., a stripe on the capacitor body).
Filtering: Used in power supplies, audio circuits, and signal processing.
Decoupling: Often used in electronic circuits to smooth voltage or filter noise.

Electrolytic capacitors are designed for applications requiring higher capacitance values and are suitable for low-frequency filtering and decoupling. Always ensure the voltage rating is not exceeded during use.

ekostra-2967.summary: CD4052 Differential 4-Channel Multiplexer/Demultiplexer 1. Function: Differential 4-Channel Mux/Demux 2. Select Code: 2-Bit Binary 3. Family: CD40xx CMOS Logic

blocks.text: The CD4052 is a differential 4-channel analog multiplexer/demultiplexer IC, routing one of 4 differential (2-line) channels to a common differential output pair based on a 2-bit binary select code.

Being differential, it switches pairs of signal lines together rather than single lines, useful for routing balanced or differential analog signals such as stereo audio channels or differential sensor pairs.
Part of the CD40xx CMOS logic family, this IC is a standard building block for differential analog signal routing circuits.
Part of the CD40xx CMOS logic family
Suited for balanced/differential analog signal routing

ekostra-2923.summary: CD4020 14-Stage Binary/Ripple Counter 1. Function: 14-Stage Binary Ripple Counter 2. Max Division: /16384 3. Family: CD40xx CMOS Logic

blocks.text: The CD4020 is a 14-stage binary ripple counter IC, counting input clock pulses through 14 cascaded binary divider stages, dividing the input frequency by up to 16384 at the final stage.
As a ripple counter, each stage triggers the next in sequence, making it a simple, low-part-count way to implement long binary counting or frequency division chains.
Part of the CD40xx CMOS logic family, this IC is a standard building block for counting and frequency division circuits.
Divides input frequency by up to 16384
Part of the CD40xx CMOS logic family
Suited for long counting and frequency division circuits

blocks.text: This is tiny and compact digital voltmeter with a red LED Display. The 0.28inch 0-100V Three Wire DC Voltmeter Red Panel requires only a few minutes of configuration and is as simple as directly connecting wires to the source you want to measure and seeing the LED blink!!!!

The red wire is to connect to the positive pole, the black wire is to connect to negative pole and the yellow/white wire is to connect to the positive pole of that source or another source across which we meant to measure the voltage. While measuring the supply voltage of another source make sure that negative pole is joined common. No need to worry even if there is any connection mismatch of the wires, the electric circuit won’t be a boom because it features reverse polarity protection.

To reach the best measurement accuracy, this voltmeter will automatically move the decimal point’s position according to the different measuring voltage. When it measures the voltage below 10V, it will display two places after the decimal point. When it measures the voltage above 10V, it will display one place after the decimal point.

This voltmeter can be used to measure the storage battery’s voltage in motorcycles and cars and also can grasp the storage battery’s status. It also can be used to measure other voltage. 30V is the voltmeter’s maximum operating limited voltage, please leave enough margin when working, to avoid voltmeter’s permanent damage because of an electrical spark, power supply ripple, or other too high abrupt change of voltage.
